evaluations.evidence: using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Distinct music search/discovery method compared with other search stories.

evaluations.evidence: based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based music discovery is a meaningfully different mechanism from fingerprinting, similar-user, content-similarity, or metadata-based discovery.

evaluations.evidence: based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Similar-user-based discovery is distinct from profile-based and content-based discovery.

evaluations.evidence: similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Input of a specific music video and inclusion of ringback tones create a meaningful difference from general fingerprint-based search.

evaluations.evidence: enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Metadata/tag-based discovery is a distinct search path from content fingerprinting, profile, and similar-user approaches.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available
evaluations.rationale: Upload/availability requirement is distinct from search, recommendation, and admin prefiltering stories.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Thumbnail-sequence viewing is unique among user stories.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Generic similar-video information is distinct enough from perceptually similar video information due to a meaningful difference in similarity type.

evaluations.evidence: perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Perceptual similarity is a specific business rule/signal, not merely another expression of generic similar-video information.

evaluations.evidence: content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation from similar profiles is distinct from search/discovery and project recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Geographically relevant news-event recommendation is distinct from other recommendation or search stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos
evaluations.rationale: Person identification is distinct from product, logo, and brand identification despite a shared pattern.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is distinct from person, logo, and brand identification.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster-logo identification is distinct from person, product, and brand identification.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification is distinct from person, product, and broadcaster-logo identification.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image
evaluations.rationale: Image-query video recommendation is distinct from other search and recommendation paths.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map
evaluations.rationale: Map-based content access is distinct from other user search and discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is distinct from other search mechanisms.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation validation/editing is unique among admin stories.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic
evaluations.rationale: Segment annotation and topic extraction is distinct from segmentation editing.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: A/V quality filtering/ranking is distinct from other prefiltering and assessment stories.

evaluations.evidence: whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Audio-edit detection is distinct from filtering, ranking, and other admin checks.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is a specific content-filtering goal not expressed by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: low-level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset search is meaningfully distinct from high-level metadata/tag search.

evaluations.evidence: copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation is distinct from filtering, ranking, and other admin stories.

evaluations.evidence: high-level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag-based prefiltering is distinct from low-level asset search.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is
evaluations.rationale: Picture interestingness/complexity assessment is distinct from scientist prompting.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject
evaluations.rationale: Scientist prompting is a distinct goal from assessing picture interestingness.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer-type identification is distinct from classification weighting.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo image preclassification is context-specific and distinct from other project preclassification stories.

evaluations.evidence: Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals
evaluations.rationale: Empty-image detection in Snapshot Serengeti is context-specific and distinct from the analogous Plankton Portal story.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection for timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Timestamping-malfunction series detection is distinct from other Snapshot Serengeti analysis stories.

evaluations.evidence: animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is distinct from attribute and number detection within Snapshot Serengeti.

evaluations.evidence: animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification is distinct from species preclassification and number detection.

evaluations.evidence: animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Animal count detection is distinct from species and attribute preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Plankton segmentation/localization is distinct from other Plankton Portal analysis stories.

evaluations.evidence: Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: Empty-image detection in Plankton Portal is context-specific and distinct from Snapshot Serengeti empty-image detection.

evaluations.evidence: plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection is distinct from segmentation, empty-image detection, and species preclassification for plankton.

evaluations.evidence: preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Plankton species preclassification is distinct from Snapshot Serengeti species preclassification by context and from other Plankton Portal stories by goal.

evaluations.evidence: worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Motion analysis for duration reduction is distinct from egg-laying time detection.

evaluations.evidence: time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Egg-laying time detection is a specific event detection goal distinct from motion-analysis duration reduction.

evaluations.evidence: areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads
evaluations.rationale: Satellite-image feature detection is distinct from artefact removal and other image-analysis stories.

evaluations.evidence: probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Weighting volunteer classifications by experience is distinct from identifying volunteer types.

evaluations.evidence: remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artefact removal is distinct from feature detection and other image-analysis goals.

evaluations.evidence: moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is distinct from artefact removal, feature detection, and preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio noise removal is distinct from other audio analysis goals such as whale call grouping or counting.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Whale-call similarity grouping has a specific context distinct from the general subject-grouping story.

evaluations.evidence: number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales in audio is distinct from grouping whale calls and from other count-detection contexts.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Interruption timing is distinct from interrupting modality, education timing, and education modality.

evaluations.evidence: interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Interruption modality is distinct from interruption timing and from education modality.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Education timing is distinct from interruption timing and from education modality/content.

evaluations.evidence: educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Education modality is distinct from interruption modality because the action is different.

evaluations.evidence: which piece of education I should give
evaluations.rationale: Selecting the education content piece is distinct from timing or modality of education.

evaluations.evidence: volunteer has made an interesting comment
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting volunteer comments is distinct from Zoonibot commenting or explaining.

evaluations.evidence: when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Zoonibot comment timing is distinct from explanation timing, what to say, and volunteer-comment detection.

evaluations.evidence: when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Explanation timing is a distinct communication goal from generic commenting and from what Zoonibot should say.

evaluations.evidence: what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Message-content selection is distinct from timing/trigger stories for Zoonibot.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: General subject grouping is distinct from whale-call grouping because of its broader context and applicability.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation for volunteers is distinct from content recommendation for users and from volunteer weighting.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization is unique among the admin stories.
